purpose: Explain repeated customer-visible failures, challenge each role's performance and adopt concrete changes for launch delivery.
format: Eight separate role-agent reviews of retained evidence, followed by cross-role questions and review of a shared working agreement. This is an agent retrospective, not customer research or a human staff meeting.
facilitatorAccountability: Root failed to enforce end-to-end ownership, clear handoffs and consistent status. Root owns enforcing the revised agreement; Steve should not supply basic regression discovery or routine internal setup.
evidenceBoundary: Read-only local review. Existing production and candidate records were inspected; live provider/hosted state was not refreshed. Reported incidents and retained reproductions are separated from inferred systemic causes.

participants.accountability: Let scoped local acceptance and adjacent releases displace the final observed customer result; basic usability failures reached Steve; current product truth fragmented.
participants.commitment: Own the complete selected customer outcome through actual use/recovery. Personally accept the observed result; keep signup/install/first request owned while Calendar progresses.
participants.finalReview: Accepted; explicit ownership of signup/install/first request; preserved both pending release and marketing hold.

participants.accountability: Serial slices, conflicting current records and repeated release interruptions weakened delivery coordination.
participants.commitment: Keep one primary outcome, one current control record and one prepared release/proof packet. Track unresolved step, driver and evidence through QA returns, operations and PO acceptance.
participants.finalReview: Accepted with G8 continuity/support retained and failed promises immediately reopened. Next checkpoint occurs when work resumes; no fictitious deadline/background staffing.

participants.accountability: Safer bounded mechanisms and proof scaffolding did not close ordinary customer integration and provider operation.
participants.commitment: Enforce separate evidence stages, finish existing Calendar path before adding machinery, and keep platform configuration with OM while customers provide only their choices and authority.
participants.finalReview: Accepted. Unknown provider outcomes retain intent/attempt/provider identity and reconcile the same operation; no blind replacement or optimistic success. These requirements are not live proof.

participants.accountability: Cross-component customer actions, asynchronous truth and ordinary deployed recovery were not carried through final acceptance.
participants.commitment: Reconcile current callback/policy/tenant/target against exact source, preserve same visit/event identity and demonstrate screen plus durable state through save/interruption/recovery.
participants.finalReview: Accepted with correction:148 customer assertions exercise actual handlers/workspace locally; only narrower sign-in suites stub destination. Ordinary scheduled recovery is required.

participants.accountability: Feature-container reviews missed coherent customer tasks, perceivable validation/help and unnecessary decisions across the journey.
participants.commitment: Own signup/install/first-request clarity with Engineering; inspect focused desktop/mobile states after ordinary actions, preserve answers, justify extra actions and provide useful recovery.
participants.finalReview: Accepted. Copying code is not installation; queued work is not delivery; Calendar does not close the rest of the customer journey.

participants.accountability: Pass totals overshadowed outcomes; contract/harness drift and reactive recovery testing left important customer handoffs unproved.
participants.commitment: Independently test actual interfaces and retained state through complete selected jobs; preserve first failures; classify stale suites; report exact proof limits and reuse valid evidence.
participants.finalReview: Accepted with refinements: ordinary scheduler rather than special dispatch, credit existing local QA, keep control small and avoid redundant gates/runs. Cross-reviewed Marketing claim stop conditions.

participants.accountability: Runbooks and healthy/deployed reports did not become demonstrated automatic service; exhausted hosting and unproved support receipt remain operational failures.
participants.commitment: Own operational Calendar proof/readiness, ordinary incident recovery, named recipient and backup, support/alert receipt, hosting continuity and honest degraded/paused state.
participants.finalReview: Accepted with G8 incident/support/capacity gaps retained. Historical active account or practice audio does not prove deployed shop voice.

participants.accountability: Setup/readiness language displaced the owner's result; research and editorial completeness were too easily confused with persuasion/price validation; the offer fragmented across surfaces.
participants.commitment: Own one benefit-led promise across site/chat/demo/pricing/onboarding, verified against actual owner outcomes. Narrow failed claims; place relevant limits at decisions; validate comprehension/value rather than infer it from research.
participants.finalReview: Accepted. Failed ordinary workflow reopens claim; distinguish request saved, owner notified and visit confirmed.876aa5d is completed local work held by the owner, not ignored work.

observedFailures: Steve repeatedly identified basic CTA/demo, visible validation, navigation, branding and copy problems after scoped green reports.
Retained actual-asset/handler reproductions show late-save typing loss and invalid callback false success; later repairs add those cases.
Current status entry points disagree on live commit, candidate and publication stage.
The complete customer installation/request and phone/text/Calendar outcomes remain unaccepted despite extensive meaningful local evidence.
The attempted controlled Calendar proof expired before consent and performed zero Google token/event operations.
Earlier credit exhaustion paused hosting; READY/health observations do not establish incident coverage or support delivery.

systemicDiagnosis.classification: Team inference from user reports and retained evidence; not a measured causal study.
findings: Acceptance favored bounded feature/test completion over a customer job spanning ordinary screens, storage, workers and providers.
Responsibilities existed but coordination failed to carry unresolved dependencies and customer consequences through final acceptance.
Test surrogates and stale contracts left gaps at handoffs; visible recovery and asynchronous state received attention after reports.
Repeated appended snapshots and parallel candidates made current truth costly to reconcile.
Marketing research and claim checks did not establish buyer comprehension, demand, willingness to pay or actual service quality.

crossChallengesResolved.challenge: PO asked why Calendar and voice were waiting behind company SMS.
crossChallengesResolved.resolution: Architect, PM and OM separated these dependencies. Calendar needs fresh normal-browser consent/current-source policy/readiness and bounded proof; voice needs its own current model, cap, offer, routing/fallback/resource and paid-proof readiness. The rejected company filing cannot justify stopping unrelated preparation.

crossChallengesResolved.challenge: UI/UX and QA asked what prior green checks actually proved.
crossChallengesResolved.resolution: Engineering corrected its overbroad stub characterization.148actual-handler assertions prove meaningful local workspace behavior; narrower destination stubs and provider doubles cannot prove complete deployed service. Focused viewport, persisted state and recovery must match the accepted task.

crossChallengesResolved.challenge: QA asked who retains signup/install/first request while Calendar progresses.
crossChallengesResolved.resolution: PO explicitly accepted accountability; UI/UX and Engineering drive, QA independently verifies and PM keeps the next unresolved step visible. Calendar is a bounded provider milestone.

crossChallengesResolved.challenge: Engineering asked how to recover a provider action whose response is lost.
crossChallengesResolved.resolution: Architect and OM require retained intent/attempt and same deterministic event/provider identity, matching owner/version readback, no blind recreation and visible uncertainty/escalation. Historical local checks are not production recovery proof.

crossChallengesResolved.challenge: Marketing asked when the team must narrow a promise.
crossChallengesResolved.resolution: Marketing, QA and PO agreed: ordinary failure, routine founder repair, lost answers or pending work labeled delivered reopen acceptance/claim. Marketing corrects, QA verifies, PO narrows or pauses; publication authority remains separate.
